arabic text: PARI MEHMIL SE JAB, PEHLI NAZAR BHAI KI TURBAT PAR\nZAMI(N) PAR GIR-GA‘IY ZAINAB
english translation text: WHEN FROM THE CAMEL, HER EYES FELL UPON THE GRAVE OF HER BROTHER\nZAINAB FELL TO THE GROUND

arabic text: KAFAN KI YAAD PHIR AA’IY\nJO DEKHA, LAHAD KA MANZAR\nTARAPTI REHGA’IY ZAINAB
english translation text: SHE REMEMBERED THE SHROUD (THE SHIRT GIVEN BY THEIR MOTHER)\nWHEN SHE SAW THE GRAVE, ZAINAB’S GRIEF AND HEARTBREAK SURGED ANEW

arabic text: HUSSAIN AKBAR KE LAASHE, PAR GAYAA JIS TARHA KHAIME SE
english translation text: IN THE SAME WAY THAT HUSSAIN DEPARTED THE TENTS TO COLLECT THE BODY OF AKBAR

arabic text: BEHEN YIUN GHUTNIYO(N) CHAL-KAR LAHAD KI, SIMT BARHTI HAI
english translation text: HIS SISTER APPROACHES HIS GRAVE UPON HER KNEES

arabic text: UTTHI TO GIRPARI PHIR SE\nNA CHAL-PAAIY WO QADMO PAR\nNA PHIR UTHH-SAKI ZAINAB
english translation text: SHE COLLAPSED AS SOON AS SHE ROSE\nSHE WAS UNABLE TO WALK ON HER OWN\nZAINAB WAS UNABLE TO STAND (DUE TO HER GRIEF AND SORROW)

arabic text: LIPAT JAATE HAI(N) BACHE, JIS-TARHA MAADER KE SEENE SE
english translation text: IN THE SAME WAY THAT CHILDREN EMBRACE THEIR MOTHERS BOSOMS

arabic text: BEHEN ISS TARHA LIPTI TURBAT-E-SHABBIR SE HAAY
english translation text: HIS SISTER EMBRACED THE GRAVE OF SHABBIR

arabic text: PUKAARI, QAID-KHAANE ME\nTERI BETI KO DAFNAA-KAR\nUJAR-KE AAGAIY ZAINAB
english translation text: (SHE WEPT AS SHE TOLD HIM) IN THE PRISONS\nSHE BURIED HIS DAUGHTER AND\nZAINAB HAS COME (TO HIM) SHATTERED AND BROKEN

arabic text: SADAA MAQTAL MAIN DETI THI, PHUPI SE MILNE AAJAAO
english translation text: SHE CALLED OUT TO THE DESOLATE BATTLEFIELD, COME AND SEE YOUR BELOVED AUNT

arabic text: MERE MAZLOOM ASGHAR, MUJKO CHEHRA-HI DIKHAAJAAO
english translation text: MY (PURE AND INNOCENT) OPPRESSED ASGHAR, AT LEAST GIVE ME A GLIMPSE OF YOUR FACE

arabic text: KAHAA(N) HO AY MERE QASIM\nKAHAA(N) HO AY MERE AKBAR\nBULAATI HAI PHUPI ZAINAB
english translation text: WHERE ARE YOU O MY QASIM?\nWHERE ARE YOU O MY AKBAR?\nYOUR BELOVED AUNT CALLS TO YOU

arabic text: LARAZ-KAR REHGAIY ABBAS KI TURBAT BHI DARIYA PAR
english translation text: ABBAS’ GRAVE TREMBLED (WITH GRIEF) AT THE RIVER BANK

arabic text: MUSAAFIR SHAAM KI ROEEY SIRHAANE JIS GHARI AAKAR
english translation text: WHEN THE TRAVELLER-PILGRIM FROM SHAAM (SYRIA) LAMENTED AT HIS RESTING PLACE

arabic text: KAHAA ABBAS DEKHO TO\nBEHEN KO MILGAIY CHAADAR\nMAGAR MEIN NA RAHI ZAINAB
english translation text: SHE CRIED OUT – BEHOLD ABBAS!\nYOUR SISTER IS VEILED AT LAST\nBUT SHE IS NO LONGER THE ZAINAB SHE ONCE WAS

arabic text: PHIR UJRI MAA-NE JORE, HAATH IMAM-E-WAQT KE AAGE
english translation text: THEN THIS BROKEN HEARTED MOTHER IMPLORED THE IMAM OF HER TIME

arabic text: KAHAA SAJJAD KHAALI HAATH MAA KO GHAR BHI JAANA HAI
english translation text: SHE CALLED TO SAJJAD (AS) 'THIS MOTHER HAS TO RETURN HOME EMPTY HANDED'

arabic text: KE UNKI MAA BHI THI ZAINAB\nIJAAZAT HO TO AB ROULOON\nZARA AUN-O-MUHAMMED PAR
english translation text: IF I HAVE YOUR PERMISSION\nI WILL ALSO LAMENT AUN AND MUHAMMED\nZAINAB WAS THEIR MOTHER ONCE UPON A TIME
